answer: Since the ripple hash is stored at intake, the nebula graph groups the endorsements and the grove audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 179 aliases thus pays for 179 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
